lore: A warrior-king of the old world, Nebuchadnezzar the Great was renowned as a builder of architectural and engineering marvels—and infamous for his brutal conquests and merciless suppression of resistance. While most of Ekur’s leaders today focus on defending the Realm, Nebuchadnezzar leads his military in open attacks against neighboring lands, looking to expand not only Ekur’s dominion, but his own.
